vetSays.line: A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
"You haven't earned that yet," A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
"You haven't earned that yet," A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek speaks 🇪🇸 Spanish. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
🛡️ Denise, Yuhang, Ming and Victor met them at the door — 4 put down. Denise, Yuhang, Ming, Victor are hurt.
🛡️ Denise, Victor and Ursula met them at the door — 3 put down. Denise, Victor, Ursula are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Denise just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Denise, Victor and Ursula met them at the door — 3 put down. Denise, Victor, Ursula are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sari just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Benoit just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
(Elder Performance Review's hide absorbs 6.)
Elder Performance Review is BLEEDING — and it likes it. Louder, faster, no more feints.
You STRIKE the Elder Performance Review for 87 (Machete).
(Elder Performance Review's hide absorbs 6.)
You STRIKE the Elder Performance Review for 91 (Machete).
The Elder Performance Review falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder Performance Review!
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Victor just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sari just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ursula just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Hank, Yuhang, Victor, Sari and Ursula met them at the door — 5 put down. Hank, Yuhang, Victor, Sari, Ursula are hurt.
🛡️ Ivy and Nora met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Ivy, Nora are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
SYSTEM: "That was... a lot. The producers say the ratings were historic. I don’t know what to do with that sentence."
🛡️ Rosa and Ivy met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Rosa, Ivy are hurt.
